title: Generate fit-ready structures without supplying a parent
hypothesis: A phase-scaled, smooth-gating parameterization contract makes seedless generation produce structures that rollout-selected fitting can improve.

prediction.against: baseline zero-shot generation prompt, given identical rollout-selected fitting
prediction.rationale: Compare confirmation success after identical treatment, not imitation loss or raw behavior; ten percentage points would warrant changing the exploration prompt.

protocol.command: gpu run -- python scripts/compare_generation_modes.py --config config/two_lane_search.yaml --research-mode seedless-fittability-contract --generation-seeds 3020 3021 3022 --fit-seeds 3023 3024 --probe-seed 3025 --probe-cases 10 --confirmation-seed 3026 --confirmation-cases 50 --checkpoints 0 125 250 500 750 1000 --model gpt-6.1-sol --reasoning-effort high --temperature 1 --max-corrections-per-slot 1 --no-promotion --require-approval --stop-gpu-on-exit
code_changes: scripts/compare_generation_modes.py: add the declared research-mode flags, approval gate, and remote shutdown handling.

scripts/compare_generation_modes.py: create three blocked prompt pairs; treatment requires bounded trainable geometry, phase-scaled parameters, and smooth transitions, without parent code, bank retrieval, or additional feedback.
scripts/compare_generation_modes.py: apply identical rollout-selected fitting to both prompts, including step zero; score every slot on confirmation rather than reporting only the winner.
scripts/compare_generation_modes.py: generate disjoint development-only manifests and report paired intervals clustered by generation block and placement.

falsified_by: The upper 95% paired interval is below +0.10; an interval containing zero leaves a directional improvement inconclusive. Invalid generation slots count as zero, not replacement opportunities.
